Name: Falling then impact
Subsystem: The falling and impact reports, and the rule that the reaction waits for the landing
Purpose: The engine reacts to the landing, not the fall, and only above an impact of 1000. Neither the threshold nor the wait has been seen on hardware. The first run of this check watched for a minute and saw only the pick-up reaction, which says nothing about falling: the drop now has a window of its own and only the falling reaction counts inside it.
ExpectedTelemetry: the RobotFalling reaction fires inside the drop's own window and nothing else satisfies it
ExpectedPhysical: He reacts when he lands, not while he is in the air.
Prerequisites: something soft to drop him onto
HumanNote: hard to tell, it might have worked

window: window RobotFalling: NOT SEEN   (in this window: CliffDetected, MotorCalibration, RobotPickedUp, ReturnedToTreads)
falling: (watching for RobotFalling for the next 45 s)
window RobotFalling: NOT SEEN   (in this window: CliffDetected, MotorCalibration, RobotPickedUp, ReturnedToTreads)
reaction: reactions fired: CliffDetected, MotorCalibration, RobotPickedUp, ReturnedToTreads
